evidence.detail: current code creates Card({'name': c['name'], 'url': image_fetcher.scryfall_image(c, 'art_crop')}) — strips key_cards to just name+url before sending
prepare_card_urls already sets c.img_url = url_for_image(...) — a site-relative URL, not a Scryfall art_crop URL
Author frames this as 'maybe it would be better' — a design question, not an actionable bug or feature requirement

triage.notes: The issue is open-ended: the author is asking whether the API should send full card objects (including image_url) or keep the current minimal name+art_crop approach. No concrete decision is stated; this is a design discussion item.
